title: Dent's Heating & Cooling: choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Directory Page. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Directory Page
options.lineage: the local phone-book page, where you found a real man with a truck and called him
options.thesis: The whole site is Dent's listing: the heading, the display ad, the number you call.
options.viewport: A yellow directory page headed HEATING & AIR CONDITIONING · ST. LOUIS. Dent's boxed display ad takes the page, with the phone number as its giant initial and a request-service form inside the ad. Thumb tabs on the edge are the navigation.
options.risk: Directory nostalgia can tip into retro kitsch if the type is timid or the yellow is softened.

raised.raise: Ink discipline: two inks only, black on directory yellow, no greys. Inverting to yellow on black is the only state change.
Grid discipline: every block snaps to the directory's column lattice and has a fixed address (section guide words), with no free-floating cards.
Annotation honesty: every listing line carries a concrete specific (zip, the step, who answers), never an adjective.
One giant entry point: the phone number is set at initial scale and outranks everything else on the page.
Type economy: one condensed grotesque family. Hierarchy comes only from size, weight and inversion.

options.label: Truck-Door Lettering
options.lineage: sign-painted service-truck doors and shop windows
options.thesis: The site is lettered like the door of the one truck that shows up.
options.viewport: A door-panel field in deep green with DENT'S lettered in gold and a drop shadow, the phone number painted underneath, and a pinstripe border holding the request form.
options.risk: The most familiar 'trades heritage' look. Many local trade sites land near here.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: Temperature data as strobing black-and-white barcode fields.
options.viewport: A barcode wall of St. Louis temperatures, with one sine curve for a service year.
options.case: Fuses poorly: North County homeowners mid-breakdown don't see themselves in a data installation, and the offer gets buried.
options.risk: Cold and abstract for a neighborly owner-operator.

options.label: Teletext Service
options.thesis: Services as numbered broadcast pages keyed by digits.
options.viewport: Page 100 lists AC, furnace, maintenance and property management as numbered rows.
options.case: Fuses, but US homeowners never lived with teletext, so audience identification is low, and the clarity is no better than the directory.
options.kept: A rigid lattice with fixed addresses for every block.

options.label: Daylight Section
options.thesis: A section through a brick bungalow showing warm and cool air moving room to room.
options.viewport: One continuous house section, with comfort zones annotated by time.
options.case: Shows what HVAC does, but not the mechanism (the owner shows up), and architectural drawing is foreign to the audience.
options.kept: Every annotation pinned to a concrete fact.

options.label: Hand-Processed Film
options.thesis: The service story as a scratched film strip.
options.viewport: Frames of a repair call along a sprocket strip.
options.case: Loses both axes. There's no real footage to carry it, and it would fake his work.
options.kept: The medium is part of the surface, not a filter.
options.risk: Needs real footage that doesn't exist.

options.label: Illuminated Initial
options.thesis: One giant letter opens into the whole story.
options.viewport: A great D whose vine circles the services.
options.case: Loses both: manuscript ornament is far from a North County HVAC call.
options.kept: One oversized entry point that outranks all text.

options.label: Festival Lineup Sheet
options.thesis: Services billed like acts, ranked by size alone.
options.viewport: AC REPAIR as the headliner, with the rest as a justified block below.
options.case: Close to the directory's grammar, but weaker on why you'd call. It holds neither axis.
options.kept: One face at many sizes; size alone carries the hierarchy.
options.risk: Billing services like bands confuses the offer.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean, trustworthy local HVAC site, done at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: A headline with the phone number and quote form beside it, then three service cards and a reviews link.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other HVAC site in St. Louis by design.
